arguments.sql:
WITH delivered AS (
  SELECT order_id, customer_id, order_purchase_timestamp
  FROM main.orders
  WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
),
customer_matches AS (
  SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS match_count,
         COUNT(customer_unique_id) AS populated_id_count
  FROM main.customers
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_order_counts AS (
  SELECT c.customer_unique_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM delivered AS d
  JOIN main.customers AS c ON c.customer_id = d.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
),
payment_rows AS (
  SELECT p.order_id, COUNT(*) AS payment_row_count, SUM(p.payment_value) AS amount
  FROM main.order_payments AS p
  JOIN delivered AS d ON d.order_id = p.order_id
  GROUP BY p.order_id
),
item_rows AS (
  SELECT i.order_id, COUNT(*) AS item_row_count,
         SUM(i.price) AS price_amount, SUM(i.freight_value) AS freight_amount
  FROM main.order_items AS i
  JOIN delivered AS d ON d.order_id = i.order_id
  GROUP BY i.order_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS delivered_rows,
       COUNT(DISTINCT d.order_id) AS distinct_delivered_orders,
       SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_count = 1 AND m.populated_id_count = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS customer_mapping_issues,
       COUNT(*) - COUNT(JULIANDAY(d.order_purchase_timestamp)) AS invalid_purchase_timestamps,
       MIN(d.order_purchase_timestamp) AS first_delivered_purchase_timestamp,
       MAX(d.order_purchase_timestamp) AS latest_delivered_purchase_timestamp,
       (SELECT MAX(order_purchase_timestamp) FROM main.orders) AS latest_purchase_timestamp_any_status,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_order_counts) AS distinct_customers,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_order_counts WHERE order_count = 1) AS one_order_customers,
       COUNT(*) - COUNT(p.amount) AS orders_without_payment_total,
       COUNT(*) - COUNT(i.price_amount) AS orders_without_item_total,
       SUM(p.payment_row_count > 1) AS orders_with_multiple_payment_rows,
       SUM(i.item_row_count > 1) AS orders_with_multiple_item_rows,
       SUM(ABS(p.amount - i.price_amount - i.freight_amount) > 0.005) AS orders_with_payment_item_freight_difference,
       ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS payment_value_sum,
       ROUND(SUM(i.price_amount), 2) AS item_price_sum,
       ROUND(SUM(i.freight_amount), 2) AS freight_value_sum,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN p.amount IS NULL THEN i.price_amount END), 2) AS item_price_on_orders_without_payments
FROM delivered AS d
LEFT JOIN customer_matches AS m ON m.customer_id = d.customer_id
LEFT JOIN payment_rows AS p ON p.order_id = d.order_id
LEFT JOIN item_rows AS i ON i.order_id = d.order_id

arguments.sql:
WITH delivered_customer_counts AS (
  SELECT c.customer_unique_id, COUNT(*) AS delivered_orders
  FROM main.orders AS o
  JOIN main.customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
),
frequency_positions AS (
  SELECT delivered_orders,
         PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY delivered_orders DESC) AS percentile_rank,
         CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY delivered_orders DESC) AS cumulative_share
  FROM delivered_customer_counts
)
SELECT delivered_orders, COUNT(*) AS customers,
       ROUND(MIN(percentile_rank), 6) AS percentile_rank,
       ROUND(MIN(cumulative_share), 6) AS cumulative_share
FROM frequency_positions
GROUP BY delivered_orders
ORDER BY delivered_orders
